Sivir

ADC Weird but works

Crit ADC Sivir

How to play this build

Use Boomerang (Q) to poke and Ricochet (W) to push the wave and gain priority. Save Spell Shield (E) to negate the enemy's key engage (a hook, a root). In teamfights, the ult (On The Hunt) lets you chase or disengage with the whole team while dealing AoE damage.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Cuchilla Bumerán → W Rebote → E Escudo de Hechizos

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Boomerang (Q) for poke and damage; Ricochet (W) second for waveclear. E at 1 point — you only need to negate one engage.

Items and what they do

  1. Berserker's Greaves Boots granting attack speed.
  2. Infinity Edge High AD, crit and increased crit damage. Core of almost every ADC.
  3. Phantom Dancer Attack speed, crit and move speed; ignores unit collision.
  4. Statikk Shiv Attack speed, crit and move speed; charges up and zaps several enemies in a chain.
  5. The Bloodthirster High AD and lifesteal; forms a shield when at full health.
  6. Blade of the Ruined King % max-health on-hit and lifesteal; active steals move speed. Melts tanks.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 goes damage so crits and waveclear hit hard.
